newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish banking sector 1996 net up to PLN 4.6 bln.
newsitem.headline: Polish banking sector 1996 net up to PLN 4.6 bln.

text.p: Polish banks recorded a net profit of 4.6 billion zlotys last year, up from 2.9 billion in 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said on Friday.
GUS said that bank revenue increased to 34.7 billion zlotys in 1996 from 29.6 billion a year earlier and pre-tax gains rose to 6.8 billion zlotys from 4.6 billion.
Interest payments contributed 56.2 percent of revenues last year while 28.9 percent came from securities, which also made up 64.1 percent of earnings.

Banking costs increased 12 percent last year to 28 billion zlotys and were mainly comprised of interest payments, which amounted to 56.3 percent of total costs, operating costs, at 22.3 percent, and provisions, 9.9 percent.
Revenue from commissions increased 42.2 percent in 1996, while costs of commissions fell 18.2 percent, which GUS said was the result of a wider range of service from banks.
